name: branding-monogram-social-profile-and-app-store-icon-mockups
title: Black 7-monogram on a social profile, app icon shelf and store listing
whatItIs: A three-part board. Left: a rounded warm-grey profile card over black with a metallic card banner, a black circular avatar with a white geometric '7', name, verified tick and follow button. Top right: a frosted shelf holding Safari, the black app icon and Slack. Bottom right: an app-store style listing card with the icon and a blue Get button.
whatItMeans: Crisp and trustworthy; a one-colour icon fits comfortably beside real apps.
techniques: Test the logo as an app icon between well-known ones.
Use a black avatar with a white symbol for strong recognition.
Present applications in realistic UI cards on a soft beige gradient.
Use a metallic macro image as a banner.

vocabulary.definition: Placing a brand icon among other app icons to check impact.
A logo used as a profile picture.
An app listing block with icon, name and Get button.
